test_title: PYST 108: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57f785396bbc1d7b191b2ce3bb1efd97361f58bbd44c172b551a5eb6da295667.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Star rotated 90 degree clockwise direction in every next figure.

2) Dark circle and blank circle is shifted one place in clockwise direction in every next figure.

3) Middle dark arrow is rotated 90 degree clockwise direction and shifted one place in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98ba4a1e9ec9dcf4c82beee888732181250169dcdf8957c68fc67e1655bb52ec.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
